metaDescription: Order custom 6X large dress shirts for your team. Perfect for uniform programs. Bulk pricing available. Get a quote today!
introHtml: When outfitting a team that includes employees who need 6X large sizes, standard dress shirts often fall short. Our selection of custom 6X large dress shirts includes options like the Men's Point Grey Dress Shirt and the Port Authority Dimension Knit Dress Shirt, offering professional fits for larger builds. These shirts accept embroidery and screen printing, making it easy to add your company logo while ensuring every team member looks sharp and feels comfortable.
heroAltText: Custom 6X large dress shirts for men and women, featuring embroidered logos, available in bulk for corporate uniforms.
